0.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_1
0.description: Welcome, traveler. This is Gridania's humble inn, the Roost.

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_2
1.description: I'm terribly sorry, but I cannot provide you a room without Mother Miounne's express permission.

2.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_Q1_000_1
2.description: What would you like to do?

5.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_3
5.description: For many years, visitors to our fair city have flocked to our establishment, certain of a warm welcome.

6.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_4
6.description: Adventurers are as migratory birds, needing a place to rest their weary wings.

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_5
7.description: Regretfully, owing to the Calamity and the shortages that followed, we have been forced to impose a strict entry policy, whereby only trusted friends of Gridania may enjoy our hospitality. Our limited resources will allow no more.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_6
8.description: To wit, if you wish to make use of our facilities, we ask that you contribute to the nation's recovery by aiding our community.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_Q2_000_1
10.description: What would you like to do?

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_11
16.description: We hope you have a pleasant stay.

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_12
17.description: We here at the Roost believe that you'll find your adventures much more rewarding if you face them well rested. Feel free to retire to one of our homey rooms whenever you find yourself in Gridania.

18.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_SYSTEM_000_13
18.description: Entering an inn room grants a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>resting<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status. This indicates that you are gradually accumulating a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rested bonus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Should you log out from inside an inn room, the process will continue while you are offline.

19.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_SYSTEM_000_14
19.description: While a rested bonus is in effect, experience points earned through combat, synthesis, and gathering are increased by 50%.

20.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_SYSTEM_000_15
20.description: When you gain experience, your rested bonus will decrease proportionally.

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_SYSTEM_000_16
21.description: Once your accumulated rested bonus disappears completely, the amount of experience you gain will revert to normal.

22.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_17
22.description: As a courtesy to your fellow guests, we ask that you refrain from making loud noises or otherwise causing a disturbance during your stay with us.

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_SYSTEM_000_18
23.description: Synthesis, repairs, and materia melding cannot be performed inside inn rooms.

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_19
24.description: Visitors to our fair city invariably seek lodgings at the Roost, keen to sample our famous hospitality.

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_20
25.description: Adventurers, you see, are as migratory birds in need of a place to rest their weary wings.

26.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_21
26.description: Whether you desire a quiet moment for reflection, or to forget your burdens in a soft bed, I'm confident our rooms will meet with your approval.

27.name: TEXT_REGFSTINNINFO_00022_ANTOINAUT_000_22
27.description: Adventurers are by their nature a restless breed, loath to see so much as a single moment go to waste, but know that repose is essential to one's continued well-being.
